pages.text: $(bold)Ranging Rope$()$(br)Hold it to see the chunk boundary underfoot, handy for judging a point range.$(br2)$(bold)Water Level Gauge$()$(br)Right-click to measure the point water level: normal is $(bold)60-66 m$(); floods run high, droughts run low - plain at a glance.
$(bold)Activated Carbon$()$(br)Right-click water to release: adsorbs impurities, lowers turbidity and pulls conductivity back toward normal.
$(bold)Cicada Acid / Alkaloid$()$(br)Cicada Acid neutralises alkali and lowers pH; Alkaloid neutralises acid and raises pH. One for each end of the scale.
$(bold)Water Oxygenator$()$(br)Right-click water to release, and it is not consumed: it balances dissolved oxygen straight to the healthy level, curing both hypoxia and oversaturation.
$(bold)Microbe Culture Dish$()$(br)Right-click water to release: beneficial microbes break down organic pollution, lowering the index - the cure for foul water.
